payload.text: ISSUE:0007's wiring on vc's brief (hv's go of 2026-11-13; devbin 0.1.23, vendored at 3c1055a, carries devbin#0326). (1) an install: block in bin/.devbin/config.yaml, with the opt prefix, the ccusage link to target/release/ccusage, LICENSE as its one file and the build's inputs, and formula.bin out; (2) ccusage --version prints T4's line through the contract's reader, with no new verb; (3) the formula on @@INSTALL@@ on macOS and Linux, each archive rooted at the install root with bin/ccusage, and the signer and its tests to match. Test what changed in a Desk cargo slot, publish to a scratch prefix only, then hand over to vc with the commit range and the one run.
